text: One decision graph for every project, in an embedded store. `decisions/log.md` is one table: it collided three times between parallel pull requests on 2026-09-28, and projects from existing code will hold far more than this repository's 95 decisions. @gitdek wants one embedded graph store for all his projects. An agent researched the engines: Kùzu was archived in October 2025, its fork LadybugDB still changes its storage format and lets only one process own a store, and DuckDB's graph extension calls itself a research project. The recommendation is SQLite used as a graph, through a pure-Go driver, with every write going through Invariant, a JSONL journal in each repository, traversal tools over MCP, graph checks in CI, and LadybugDB as the planned upgrade. @gitdek ratified it with all five recommendations: B, each project's own decision IDs under its name, one store on the factory's machine rebuilt from the journals elsewhere, `decisions/journal.jsonl` in each repository, and slice 12, before the Codex backend.
